name: 1138-batchdecode-dsv2lite-1gpu
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat. Ungated on the Hub, ~31 GB of bf16 weights, and in this engine's model registry.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 2000 requests with a 1200 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets: prompts centred on 236 tokens (stdev 180, clamped 16-1024) and generations centred on 216 tokens (stdev 160, clamped 16-768). Seed 42.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant handling short single-turn exchanges for 256 concurrent users on one H100.
launch:
# sglang 0.2.13 server arguments. Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is skipped
# when this file is read, so a re-flowed value is silently dropped.
model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat

# The checkpoint ships its own configuration/modeling modules and its tokenizer needs them.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 1

enable-mla: true

disable-radix-cache: true

# LOAD-BEARING, NOT COSMETIC: the checkpoint advertises 163840 positions, and the request table
# the engine allocates is (max requests) x (context length + 8) int32 on the device -- at the
# advertised window that is terabytes and the server never starts. The longest possible request
# here is 1024 + 768 = 1792, so nothing is truncated.
context-length: 4096

mem-fraction-static: 0.85

random-seed: 42
